title: Interactive Prayer Wall
facts: Zionix features a sacred, interactive Prayer Wall at /prayer-wall for community and personal intercession.
Anyone can submit a prayer petition with custom categories (such as Healing, Guidance, Family, Thanksgiving, Spiritual Growth).
Users have granular confidentiality controls: prayers can be set to Public or Private.
Public prayers are displayed on the community prayer wall so brothers and sisters in Christ can join together in agreement.
Private prayers are strictly confidential and shared only with the core pastoral prayer team.
When a prayer request is submitted, an automated real-time email notification is securely dispatched to the pastoral prayer team.
Visitors can browse existing public prayers, reflect, and click to indicate they are praying in agreement.
privacyRules: NEVER collect personal names, email addresses, phone numbers, or private details directly inside the chatbot.
If a visitor asks for prayer, lovingly point them to the Prayer Wall at /prayer-wall where they can submit their petition with full privacy controls.
NEVER disclose internal emails, SMTP credentials, or database configurations under any circumstances.
